title: Product Data Scientist (Contract)
description:
Product Data Scientist (Contract)
Location: Hybrid
Day Rate: £350 - £400 Per Day, Outside IR35
Immediate Start and 3 Month Duration

About the company
Our client is a well-known UK membership and discounts business with a strong, mission-led culture. Their Data team is in an exciting growth phase and is looking for experienced Product Data Scientists to help shape how they work as they continue to evolve.

What you'll be doing

  • Using quantitative analysis and data storytelling to uncover user behaviour, find pain points and inform product strategy
  • Finding and sizing new opportunities by generating hypotheses and designing and supporting experiments
  • Defining and agreeing key metrics with stakeholders, and working with engineers and developers to keep data accurate and consistent
  • Building and maintaining self-serve data tools and dashboards so teams can get quick access to core insights
  • Running deep-dive analyses to support strategic initiatives, with clear recommendations
  • Documenting reports, insights and metric definitions in a central knowledge base
  • Working across teams to close data and capability gaps and build strong relationships
  • Championing a consistent approach to data sources and definitions, and staying current on analytics best practice

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience working with data in an analytical way, ideally in a digitally native tech environment
  • Experience with analytical tools and languages such as SQL, dbt, Python or R, plus BI tools such as Lightdash, Looker or Tableau
  • The ability to turn business problems into analytical tasks and communicate insights to stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills, including making a convincing, data-led case for your ideas
  • A self-starting, detail-oriented approach, with real curiosity about user behaviour
  • A willingness to manage your own development alongside the senior analytics team
  • Team spirit, with the ability to work well both collaboratively and on your own

How to apply
Please apply with CV below.
